Tests and traceplot work follow on 2018-03-07, and the monthly series has activity in every subsequent month. Source: aamphone_project_gap_commits.csv and monthly series.

After the 2024-11 through 2025-03 gap, optional query-parameter work resumes on 2025-04-28 (45e4466cc9). Source: aamphone_project_gap_commits.csv and https://github.com/ImagingDataCommons/dicomweb-client/pull/108.

Exclude the apparent 67-month gap caused by inherited website timestamps: 9c858f2264 has author date 2014-03-21 but committer date 2021-07-30. New README work starts in 2016-12 and packaging/refactoring follows in 2017-09 under a different author. After the 10-month gap (2022-09 through 2023-06), backend work resumes on 2023-07-31 and continues through August with NumPyro integration, tests and documentation. Additional development continues in 2024-2025. Source: aamphone_project_gap_commits.csv and monthly series.

Every month from 2017-12 through the final observed month, 2025-11, has commits. There is no zero-commit interval to recover from. N/A is an exception to the binary codebook. Source: aamphone_commits_timeseries_geolytix_xyz.csv.

This is resumption after a short pause rather than evidence of earlier abandonment. Source: gap commits and monthly series.

After the 32-month gap, work resumes on 2025-05-11 with upstream CRAN/check fixes and release preparation. WoC records 12 post-gap commits that day, and the upstream history includes the merged fixes and CRAN submission. The return is brief, but it is actual resumed maintenance after the gap. Source: gap commits, monthly series and https://github.com/kkondo1981/aglm/commit/5f25d77f62.

Following the 18-month gap, upstream work resumes on 2023-08-19 with rebuild/check maintenance. Further package and example changes follow in June 2024, then documentation in January 2025. These 10 post-gap commits establish resumed activity even though upkeep is sparse and the last recorded commit is 2025-01-09. Later inactivity is assessed separately in Currentstatus. Source: gap commits, monthly series and https://github.com/WinVector/vtreat/commit/6fa2eb97db.

AuthorValue: Decision to make it a backend-independent library: 2018-03-06 'begin pymc3-independence process', tests and traceplot added the next day, README renamed to ArviZ on 2018-03-23 (PR #34), first release 0.1.0 in 2018-09.
ValidatorValue: Development restarted to turn the PyMC3 plotting code into an independent library, with tests and plotting features added immediately afterward.
KeyEvidence: 057a7f4396 (2018-03-06) starts PyMC3 independence. 2611d7c5a5 adds tests and 2e86cb9ba9 adds traceplot/helper functions on 2018-03-07. These messages directly support the independence/relaunch explanation. Source: aamphone_project_gap_commits.csv.

AuthorValue: Downstream users needed features: developers from openradx, who use the client in their ADIT project (PR #108 discussion), added optional query parameters to the search/retrieve/store/delete methods (issue #105, PR #108, merged 2025-05-13) and modern tooling; maintainers released v0.60.0 on 2025-05-24.
ValidatorValue: Downstream users contributed extra query-parameter support and tests. Returning maintainers reviewed the contribution and resumed releases.
KeyEvidence: PR #108 adds optional HTTP parameters across search, retrieval, storage and deletion methods. Its discussion identifies the openradx/ADIT users and a maintainer transition. Merge date: 2025-05-13. This supports user demand as the recovery trigger. Source: https://github.com/ImagingDataCommons/dicomweb-client/pull/108.

AuthorValue: Nothing to recover from: the gap ends when the project was created (2019-11). The longest real gap (2023-12 to 2024-07, 8 months) ended on 2024-08-27 when Chris Jefferson bundled BacktrackKit/GraphBacktracking and updated dependencies, leading to release v0.6.0 (2025-01).
ValidatorValue: After excluding the inherited website timestamp, development resumed after the longest genuine gap with BacktrackKit/GraphBacktracking bundling and dependency updates in August 2024.
KeyEvidence: For the genuine gap (2023-12 through 2024-07), beb17e8310 imports BacktrackKit/GraphBacktracking and be273f1d74 updates dependencies on 2024-08-27. This agrees with the author explanation of the later genuine return, although the HasRecovered label differs because the validator assesses the corrected gap. Source: aamphone_project_summary.csv and https://github.com/peal/vole/commit/9c858f2264.

AuthorValue: The gap ends when nbara created the project ('Create README.md', 2016-12-15) and later refactored the old code ('Refactor code': python 2->3, Travis, setup.py, 2017-09-08).
ValidatorValue: N/A for recovery of the same project across the computed gap. Nicolas Barascud reused the earlier implementation and developed it into an installable Python 3 package.
KeyEvidence: 9b499bda46 creates README.md on 2016-12-15. The full message of d7e14d956c on 2017-09-08 explicitly lists Python 2-to-3 conversion, Travis, setup files and making the package installable. README credits Pedro Alcocer for the earlier implementation. Source: aamphone_project_summary.csv and upstream README.

AuthorValue: Problems with the greta (TensorFlow) backend: from 2023-07-31 the commits move inference to numpyro ('got numpyro and install issues working', 'exchanging greta for numpyro in examples'). NEWS for 0.5.2 (on CRAN 2023-08-19): 'Switched inference to Python's numpyro; dag_greta() is now deprecated'.
ValidatorValue: Development restarted to replace the greta backend with NumPyro and resolve installation/backend compatibility issues.
KeyEvidence: 864285fe79 (2023-07-31) introduces NumPyro work. 0bc835a736 (2023-08-04) reports NumPyro and installation issues working. a0d4f6e111 (2023-08-05) replaces greta in examples. NEWS for 0.5.2 confirms the backend switch. Source: gap commits and https://github.com/flyaflya/causact/blob/master/NEWS.md.
The monthly series has no inactivity gap, so no recovery trigger applies. Source: aamphone_commits_timeseries_geolytix_xyz.csv.

AuthorValue: Dependency breakage, not new features: PR #43 'fix requirement' (setup.py, requirements.txt, 2024-04-19), PR #45 'pin protobuf dep', and PR #44 'remove dependency on old Mock', followed by release 3.2.12 (2024-08-22).
ValidatorValue: Dependency compatibility maintenance appears to have prompted the return: requirements updates, removal of old Mock and protobuf pinning, followed by further maintenance.
KeyEvidence: b140ad8e07 and bb3fa9b58a update setup.py/requirements.txt on 2024-04-19. PR #43 is titled fix requirement. Later commits remove old Mock (cc6b469da9) and pin protobuf (2ebd74653a). Compatibility as the motive is an inference from the changes, not an explicit maintainer statement. Source: gap commits and https://github.com/genouest/biomaj-download/pull/43.

AuthorValue: Next development cycle: website update (2021-06-22), API refactors ('extent is a free function #297', 'refactor for #298') and a code-wide clang-format pass (#116), leading to v0.11.0 (2021-10).
ValidatorValue: Work resumed with website updates, API refactoring and code formatting, consistent with another development cycle after release preparation.
KeyEvidence: The pre-gap 2ae94d68bf updates the version on 2021-04-29. Post-gap 39c6218710 updates the website, 1cfc8031fb changes the extent API and 85301b563d reformats source. The development-cycle explanation is plausible but no explicit motivating statement appears in these messages. Source: aamphone_project_gap_commits.csv.

AuthorValue: CRAN maintenance: on 2025-05-11/12 PRs #67–#69 'Fix cran 202505' ('ignore missing package anchors NOTEs in CRAN build', 'Added an import directive to avoid NOTEs in check()', new cran-comments.md). Version 0.4.1 was published on CRAN on 2025-05-12, then the repo went quiet again.
ValidatorValue: Work resumed to resolve CRAN check problems and prepare a CRAN release.
KeyEvidence: The post-gap messages mention missing package anchors, an import directive to avoid check NOTEs, cran-comments.md and fix-cran-202505 PRs. 5f25d77f62 submits to CRAN. These messages support CRAN check and release maintenance as the reason for the return. Source: gap/recent commits and https://github.com/kkondo1981/aglm/pull/69.

AuthorValue: Brief CRAN upkeep, not a revival: 2023-08-19 'rebuild and recheck' (1.6.4); 2024-06-12 'work on thinning package' (1.6.5, dropped the isotone and lme4 dependencies); documentation examples in January 2025. No commits since 2025-01-09.
ValidatorValue: Work resumed for package build/check maintenance, dependency reduction and documentation examples.

The maintenance explanation agrees with the author evidence, while the HasRecovered row records the difference over whether that work counts as recovery. Source: aamphone_project_gap_commits.csv.
